# Governance

Canonical governance model: [`GOVERNANCE.adoc`](../GOVERNANCE.adoc).
Maintainer roster and responsibilities: [`MAINTAINERS.adoc`](../MAINTAINERS.adoc).

`0patch-lsa-sentinel` is maintained by Jonathan D.A. Jewell
([`@hyperpolymath`](https://github.com/hyperpolymath)). Bug fixes and minor
updates may land via reviewed pull request; architectural changes or updates to
the proved classifier / C-ABI seam (`core-spark/`, `abi-idris2/`, `ffi-zig/`,
`host-rust/`) require issue discussion, signed commits, and passing proof/test
gates. See [`GOVERNANCE.adoc`](../GOVERNANCE.adoc) for full details.
